source_title: UNESCO Global Education Monitoring 2026 quality education
direct_observation: more than half of lower-secondary students reported bullying in 70 of 83 countries with data; 3909 attacks on education recorded in 69 countries in 2024
evidence_status: high for bounded global signal; peer violence and conflict attacks are separate pathways
next_test: link school-level exposure and response to attendance, learning and recurrence

source_title: UNESCO Safe to learn and thrive
unit_or_scope: global school violence and identity groups
direct_observation: violence affects learning health and dropout; gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status and identity shape exposure
evidence_status: high for mechanism and inequality framing; local attribution remains open
next_test: compare named groups, routes, reporting, response and support

source_title: WHO Europe HBSC bullying and cyberbullying
direct_observation: about 15% reported being cyberbullied; cyberbullying increased from 2018
evidence_status: high for regional trend; school-platform-family causal chain remains open
next_test: follow named student exposure, platform action, school response and wellbeing

evidence_status: high for policy gap; enforcement, disclosure safety and case outcomes remain open
next_test: audit law, school protocol, reporting, response and remedy in one jurisdiction

evidence_status: bounded case evidence; long-term population effect remains open

source_title: UNICEF West and Central Africa education under crisis
unit_or_scope: schools and children affected by conflict closures 2019-2025
direct_observation: nearly 15000 schools closed due to violence and conflict; about three million children affected in 2025
evidence_status: high for conflict continuity signal; named child recovery and safe return remain open
next_test: follow school closure, displacement, trauma support, reopening, attendance and learning
